page_title: VAL 0-0 CEL | Valencia v Celta Vigo 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.
90+2' A substitution has been made. Diego Lopez is replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
90+2' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Hugo Guillamon (Valencia).
90+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Selim Amallah (Valencia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:13.
87' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Pepelu (Valencia) for his blatant foul.
85' Rafael Benitez decides to make a substitution. Oscar Mingueza will be replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
85' The game has come to an end for Iago Aspas. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo).
84' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) replacing Hugo Duro.
84' It is time for a substitution. Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) is on for Fran Perez.

82' That was a nice football moment. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Giorgi Mamardashvili guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
80' Valencia earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
79' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Selim Amallah (Valencia) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' A crossfield pass from Thierry Correia (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates.
74' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
72' Selim Amallah (Valencia) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the left post!
72' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) will take the free kick.
71' A yellow card for a tackle by Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo). Cesar Soto Grado doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
70' Celta Vigo couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
70' Javi Guerra (Valencia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
68' Fran Perez (Valencia) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jorgen Strand Larsen leaves the pitch and Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) comes on.
67' Substitution. Jonathan Bamba did his best and is replaced by Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo).
67' Rafael Benitez has decided to make a change. Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) replaces Kevin Vazquez.
66' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
65' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) delivers a long cross in an attempt to surprise the opponent's sleepy defence.
64' That's the end of the game for Sergi Canos, who is replaced by Selim Amallah (Valencia).
63' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
62' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
61' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:6.
54' The attendance is 43375.
52' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
50' Thierry Correia (Valencia) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Here comes a substitution. Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Jose Gaya.
46' The whistle blows and Cesar Soto Grado starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Fran Perez (Valencia) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45+3' Valencia will take a corner kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Rough tackle by Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Valencia.
42' A free kick is awarded to Valencia.
42' Dangerous play by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo). Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Fran Perez (Valencia) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
40' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo).
37' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
36' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
34' There's an opportunity for Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
33' Valencia concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
30' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' Big chance! A simple pass from Jose Gaya left Hugo Duro (Valencia) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
26' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
25' Jose Gaya (Valencia) and Hugo Duro try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
23' Thierry Correia (Valencia) sends a long ball in, but Vicente Guaita comfortably gathers the ball.
20' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) is penalised for holding. Cesar Soto Grado signals a set piece.
19' Fran Perez (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but Vicente Guaita comes off his line to gather the ball.

19' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went wide of the right post by a whisker.
19' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes a direct free kick.
18' A dangerous looking corner kick from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is cleared to safety by the defence.
16' Thierry Correia (Valencia) and Javi Guerra combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
16' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but it's cleared.
14' Javi Guerra (Valencia) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
12' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
12' Celta Vigo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
9' What a sweet pass and great technique by Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) as he finds his teammate with a precise lofted through ball.
9' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
8' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game. One of the players from Valencia won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
7' Valencia keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
6' A pass from Diego Lopez (Valencia) is intercepted by Vicente Guaita and the move breaks down.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
5' Hugo Duro (Valencia) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar.
3' Valencia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' The Valencia players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has started.
Valencia will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Cesar Soto Grado.
